current_scoring_rules.conditions: An actual observation links actual source_ref, subject_refs, source_subject_refs, measurements and native/text/image provenance. source_content/source_annotation/coordinate_mapping are excluded from axis mappings.
Current assessment revision must belong to the interpreted hypothesis; replaced/withdrawn findings are inactive. Assessment states relation, applicability, extent_basis and condition/assumption refs.

CreditPolicy.observation_axes maps kind to one base component: assay_report/biochemical_assay/genetic_phenotype/growth_assay/read_support -> empirical; alignment/profile_match/comparison/gene_prediction -> comparative; structure_match/mechanism/reaction_context -> mechanistic; context_measurement/context/taxonomy_assignment/sequence_composition -> biological_context. Mapping excludes discrimination. Typed hypothesis predicate/value are not examined in this component lookup.

weight = bound applicability weight * bound relation weight * extent factor. Numeric measurement magnitudes (identity, evalue, activity etc.) do not become reliability weights here; query_coverage is an extent factor when no exact mapping applies. Current default applicability: direct1,transfer.6,contextual.35,scope_limited.2,incomparable0; relation: strengthens1,weakens1,mixed.5,does_not_discriminate0. These are existing proxy settings, not proposed or validated constants.

Observed extent clips actual source/native operand geometry. Inferred extent requires explicit bounded target_footprint and cannot be direct; a source reference does not acquire target coordinates. context_allocation requires explicit nonempty original-material allocation in both assessment and account; it is not a measurement. Coverage is not applied twice to an exactly mapped native interval.

For each coherent account and material cell: supported disposition uses strengthening/mixed as positive, weakening/mixed as opposing; weakened reverses those relation roles. Unresolved contributes relation-weighted evidence with unresolved_factor and no opposing row. Component = max(positive weights)/(1+max(opposing weights)). All-zero absence gives0.

Weakened+weakens/mixed yields discrimination; unresolved+weakens/mixed yields factor-scaled discrimination. A supported strengthening row also yields discrimination if the SAME observation weakens another explicit weakened/unresolved hypothesis; derived weight=min(the two weights). Same observation can therefore affect a base component and discrimination. This is existing arithmetic, not another experiment or parent action.

Compatible hypotheses are declared by the episode in coherent_sets. Each cell chooses the whole highest-volume account, not per-axis fusion from incompatible accounts; copies cannot sum. Within a base axis maxima prevent independent evidence accumulation as well as duplicate inflation. No source-family independence model is present.

For existing fixed five axes, H=(product((epsilon+(1-epsilon)*component)^axis_weight)-epsilon^sum_weights)/(1-epsilon^sum_weights). Integrate per-cell H over fixed original eligible position mass, then fixed target weights and bound scale. No candidate-count reward/historical-best clamp. AnnotationSupportScore selects stable equal-component integer-mass integration; old bindings retain their frozen arithmetic.

Separate standard channel: finding_unit * count(distinct current retained typed finding keys actually known to the receiving episode). Key=normalized target question+source claim+qualification; relation/applicability/disposition/episode/account/quotation do not add units. Valid negative/limited findings remain eligible; correction can retire a known key; replacement counts only when received.

Progress normalizes primary metadata DOI/PMCID/PMID, exact XLSX workbook lineage, typed source subjects and explicit same_source_claim_as_ref. It does not infer arbitrary synonyms or independent experiments. Annotation projection uses max within each axis; it does not canonicalize same-study dependency across different base axes. A source_ref alone is custody identity, not proof of independent biological evidence.

preserved_observations.source_locator: Cas1-Cas2 complex formation is required in vivo; Fig. 3 and supplementary stability comparison
preserved_observations.observation: Cas2 C-terminal beta6-beta7 deletion prevents detectable acquisition and stable co-precipitation with Cas1. Cas1 R252E similarly loses stable complex formation and acquisition, while purified R252E retains the expected Cas1-dimer gel-filtration behavior. Single Cas2 E65R is tolerated; E65R/D84R double substitution abolishes acquisition. Tolerated Cas1-tail deletion and Cas2 E65R retain complex formation.
preserved_observations.limit: A deletion can affect more than one local contact. The study does not provide a complete independent folding/stability assay for every Cas2 variant, so these are not all proven interface-only perturbations.

preserved_observations.source_locator: The catalytic activity of Cas2 is dispensable in vivo; Fig. 4c-d,g-h
preserved_observations.observation: E. coli Cas2 E9A and E9R support PCR-detected spacer acquisition at levels described as similar to wild type; E9 mutation also retains complex formation and lysate CRISPR-bait recognition. Cas2 R14A retains acquisition, whereas interface-associated R18A has low acquisition. Cas1 conserved active-site alanine substitutions abolish acquisition.
preserved_observations.limit: The directly measured result is acquisition/assembly/bait behavior of E. coli mutants. The loss-of-nuclease expectation relies on the conserved-site interpretation and earlier other-species assays; no direct E. coli E9-mutant nuclease-null assay is demonstrated by this reading. No new quantitative frequency or statistical equivalence was calculated here.

preserved_observations.source_locator: Protospacer DNA integration by Cas1-Cas2; Fig. 1 and Extended Data Figs. 2-3
preserved_observations.observation: Purified Cas1/Cas2 joins labelled protospacers covalently to plasmid DNA. Cas1 H208A and D221A are defective; Cas2 E9Q supports integration. Cas2 beta6-beta7 deletion fails to support the reaction. Cas1 alone gives low integration with Mn2+, and Cas2 substantially enhances integration.
preserved_observations.limit: Cas2 is required for efficient tested complex behavior, not for every detectable Cas1 strand-transfer event under all conditions. These integration assays do not demonstrate every stage of immune protection or protospacer generation.

preserved_observations.source_locator: Integration and disintegration products; Integration requires 3-prime-OH protospacer ends
preserved_observations.observation: Radiolabel incorporation and product analysis distinguish integration products from plasmid topoisomers. Band X is not radiolabelled and is interpreted through disintegration/topology experiments. Blocking both protospacer 3-prime hydroxyls prevents integration; Cas1 also catalyses disintegration of a defined half-site substrate.
preserved_observations.limit: A change in plasmid migration is not automatically covalent spacer integration. Cas1's demonstrated integrase strand-transfer role must not be collapsed into an unsupported requirement that Cas1 or Cas2 cuts donor DNA to generate all prespacers.

preserved_observations.source_locator: The Cas1-Cas2 complex is essential for CRISPR locus binding
preserved_observations.observation: Purified complexes were not sequence-specific in the tested EMSA. In lysate CRISPR-target-bait precipitation, Cas1 preference depends on Cas2 and a compatible complex, although Cas2 itself is not detected in washed eluates.
preserved_observations.limit: No Cas2 in a washed target-bait eluate does not establish absence of all direct Cas2-DNA contacts. This is target-locus DNA in lysate, distinct from the donor protospacer captured in the later structure.

preserved_observations.observation: A four-Cas1/two-Cas2 complex positions the central donor duplex over Cas2 and terminal donor 3-prime ends in two Cas1 sites. Cas2 R16/R78 are part of a phosphate-backbone clamp; R16E and R78E strongly reduce in vivo acquisition, whereas R77E is tolerated. Cas1 clamp/channel and end-splaying mutants supply additional functional comparisons.
preserved_observations.limit: Contact presence alone does not establish functional necessity: R77 is an explicit tolerated contact-site example. Not every Cas2 contact mutant was directly assayed for binding affinity in isolation.

preserved_observations.method: Biopython 1.88 reads model 1, author chain/residue numbering. Euclidean nearest-heavy-atom comparisons within deposited assembly-1 atoms; no added symmetry mates. Polar groups are Glu OE1/OE2, Asp OD1/OD2 and Arg NE/NH1/NH2. DNA phosphate targets are OP1/OP2. Full atom-pair records and file hashes are saved.
actual_results: Across both Cas2 copies and both structures, R16 terminal-polar-group to DNA phosphate oxygen minima are 2.490-2.879 A; R78 minima are 2.378-3.017 A.

Cas2 R18 side-chain to Cas1 minima are 2.726-3.070 A, consistently at the Cas1 backbone near residue 4. The E9 side-chain to Cas1 minima are 13.834-14.602 A, spatially separating the signature acidic site from this direct inter-protein contact in these models.
The two donor terminal O3-prime atoms lie 2.879-3.558 A from H208 NE2 in Cas1 chains A/C. Cas2 E9 carboxylate-to-nearest donor terminal O3-prime distances are 47.547-50.240 A.

E9 is not simply remote from every DNA atom: all-side-chain nearest-DNA distances range from 3.902 to 4.213 A, and terminal-carboxylate to phosphate-oxygen minima range from 4.511 to 5.822 A. Geometry therefore cannot be used as a proof of no DNA interaction or no nuclease chemistry.
preserved_observations.changed_inference: The deposited models support spatially distinct contributions: a Cas2 central donor-DNA surface and Cas1-assembly interface versus Cas1 integration-end positioning. This is a positive structural explanation compatible with the functional mutant results, rather than inferring a scaffold solely from a catalytic-site mutant that still works.
preserved_observations.limits: Static 2.951/3.2-A models, approximate distances, no energetic or hydrogen-bond inference, no density/refinement analysis, no binding measurement, no mutant structural simulation and no independent proof that E9 is catalytically inactive. The two structures are related preparations from one study, not independent biological replications.
